Title: Art & Creativity Day
Description: Facilitated by Subraato Dalu, a school teacher from the community. Participants explored art using naturally available materials like leaves and old newspapers.

Title: Health & Hygiene Day
Description: Yoga, warm-up exercises, nutrition and hygiene led by Gautam Dalu and Sukanta Bhowmick — showing how locally available food meets nutritional needs.

Title: Library Session
Description: Interactive reading, quizzes and library games led by Suman Biswas and Arjun, trained by Mitraja in collaboration with Free Library Network.

Title: Pottery & Creativity Workshop
Description: Hands-on Goalparia pottery with Banamallika Choudhary, Founder of Mudhill Pottery, with special guest Sisir Basumatary.

Title: Community Leadership & Green Skills
Description: Local flora, medicinal plants and traditional plantation techniques with Jugantar Hazong and Nitai Sarkar; leadership facilitated by Maheswar Hazong.

Title: Sports Day
Description: A full day of sport led by Plabon Hazong and Dalim Dalu, with the SELCO Kokrajhar team as special guests — the single biggest driver of community unity all week.

Title: Closing Ceremony
Description: Dance, music, community lunch and prize distribution, with special guest Benjamin Kamak of Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Dudhnoi.

Title: Apollo Library open hours
Description: Weekly reading and lending hours at the Apollo Library, run by trained community volunteers.

Title: Crochet & Knitting Workshop
Description: Ongoing collaborative sessions with Kasiyoli Store building alternative livelihood skills for local women.

Title: Bamboo Work Workshop
Description: Traditional bamboo craft training, using the same skills the community used to rebuild the Apollo Club itself.

Title: Photography Workshop
Description: Youth trained to document their own community and craft — building both a skill and a visual record of Mitraja's work.

Title: Apollo Club Reopening
Description: The Apollo Club reopened after community members restored its old bamboo structure through voluntary labour.
